input_plan.query: Which pairs of different ASRS incident IDs, up to twenty in total, most likely describe the same underlying occurrence? Compare only reports sharing incident month, state reference, locale-reference type, and primary problem, but require the narratives to agree on a distinctive event sequence, measurements, actions, and outcome rather than merely discussing the same topic. Rank matched pairs by incident month descending and then both incident IDs ascending. For each pair, give the shared primary event type and list which of flight phase, anomaly summary, and result summary differ between the two structured records.

reference_semantic_plan.program:
left_incidents := (
  SCAN_TABLE(NASA_ASRS, incidents.csv AS left_incident, [incident_id,incident_date,state_reference,locale_reference_type,primary_problem,flight_phase,anomaly_summary,result_summary,text_file])
)
right_incidents := (
  SCAN_TABLE(NASA_ASRS, incidents.csv AS right_incident, [incident_id,incident_date,state_reference,locale_reference_type,primary_problem,flight_phase,anomaly_summary,result_summary,text_file])
)
blocked_pairs := JOIN(left=left_incidents, right=right_incidents, join_type=inner, condition=left_incident.incident_id < right_incident.incident_id AND left_incident.incident_date = right_incident.incident_date AND left_incident.state_reference = right_incident.state_reference AND left_incident.locale_reference_type = right_incident.locale_reference_type AND left_incident.primary_problem = right_incident.primary_problem)
left_signatures := (
  blocked_pairs
  -> SCAN_DOCS(NASA_ASRS, selector=blocked_pairs.left_incident.text_file, [left_incident_id, right_incident_id, left_text])
  -> SEM_EXTRACT("Preserve both blocked-pair incident IDs and extract a normalized primary_event_type from {equipment_failure,airborne_conflict,ground_conflict,clearance_deviation,weather_event,maintenance_event,cabin_event,other}, plus distinctive measurements, action sequence, and outcome from the left report.", {left_incident_id:string,right_incident_id:string,left_primary_event_type:string,left_measurements:list[string],left_action_sequence:list[string],left_outcome:string}, {left_incident_id,right_incident_id,left_text})
)
right_signatures := (
  blocked_pairs
  -> SCAN_DOCS(NASA_ASRS, selector=blocked_pairs.right_incident.text_file, [left_incident_id, right_incident_id, right_text])
  -> SEM_EXTRACT("Preserve both blocked-pair incident IDs and extract the same normalized event signature from the right report.", {left_incident_id:string,right_incident_id:string,right_primary_event_type:string,right_measurements:list[string],right_action_sequence:list[string],right_outcome:string}, {left_incident_id,right_incident_id,right_text})
)
matched_pairs := SEM_JOIN(left=left_signatures, right=right_signatures, instruction="Compare only signature rows carrying the same left and right blocked-pair incident IDs. Keep the pair only when both narratives describe the same underlying occurrence, requiring agreement on a distinctive event progression and compatible measurements, actions, and outcome. Generic topical similarity is insufficient.", input_bindings_left={left_incident_id,right_incident_id,left_primary_event_type,left_measurements,left_action_sequence,left_outcome}, input_bindings_right={left_incident_id,right_incident_id,right_primary_event_type,right_measurements,right_action_sequence,right_outcome})
matched_pairs
-> PROJECT([left_incident_id,right_incident_id,incident_date=left_incident.incident_date,shared_primary_event_type=left_primary_event_type,differing_structured_fields=DIFF_FIELD_NAMES(left_incident,right_incident,[flight_phase,anomaly_summary,result_summary])])
-> ORDER_BY([incident_date DESC,left_incident_id ASC,right_incident_id ASC])
-> LIMIT(20)
-> PROJECT([rank=ROW_NUMBER(),left_incident_id,right_incident_id,incident_date,shared_primary_event_type,differing_structured_fields])
